The gateway is not on the host's subnet

Configuring the correct gateway (option 3) in the DHCP scope

Correct the gateway to the subnet's router address

The DHCP scope's gateway option for that VLAN

Which practice helps catch gateway errors across many hosts?
Verifying DHCP-provided settings and using monitoring

The FHRP moved the virtual gateway to the standby router
The gateway changed on the host

Loss of connectivity if that router fails
Which symptom suggests all hosts in a subnet have a wrong gateway?
No host in the subnet can reach other networks
Which practice helps fix a subnet-wide gateway error provided by DHCP?
Correcting the gateway in the DHCP scope and renewing leases
A host can reach the internet but not an internal remote subnet. Could the gateway be involved?
Possibly, if the gateway lacks a route to that internal subnet
Which practice confirms a gateway fix resolved remote connectivity?
Testing access to a remote network after the change
A host has no gateway configured at all. What is the symptom?
It can reach local hosts but not other networks
Which command on Linux shows the default gateway?
A new subnet's hosts can't reach others, but the gateway router interface is up. What else should be checked?
That hosts point to the correct gateway and the router has routes
Which symptom indicates a typo in a static gateway address?
The host can't reach remote networks and can't ping the gateway
Which practice helps avoid gateway typos?
Using DHCP for gateway assignment where possible
A host's gateway is correct, but remote access still fails. What else could be wrong?
The gateway router's upstream routing or an ACL
Which practice helps document gateway settings per subnet?
Recording gateways in IPAM and network documentation
A host receives DHCP but has no gateway. What should be checked in DHCP?
Whether option 3 (router) is configured in the scope
Which symptom helps confirm the gateway is the issue versus the host's NIC?
The host can reach local devices, ruling out a dead NIC
A laptop works at the office but has the office gateway hard-coded elsewhere. What is the fix?
Use DHCP so the correct gateway is assigned per network
Which practice helps verify the gateway on multiple VLANs?
Checking each VLAN's SVI/router address and DHCP option
A host's gateway is set to its own IP by mistake. What is the symptom?
No remote connectivity because the host points to itself
Which tool helps confirm the gateway is forwarding traffic?
A subnet was re-addressed, but hosts still use the old gateway. What is the fix?
Update the gateway (via DHCP or statically) to the new router address
Which practice helps prevent gateway issues after a router replacement?
Ensuring the new router uses the same gateway address or updating clients
A host has two NICs and uses the wrong one's gateway. What should be checked?
The interface metrics and which gateway is active
Which symptom suggests a gateway reachable at Layer 2 but not routing?
The gateway pings but remote networks are unreachable
Which practice confirms the gateway's own connectivity upstream?
Testing from the gateway router to upstream networks
A host's gateway is correct but on a down interface of the router. What is the effect?
No remote connectivity until the interface is restored
Which practice helps troubleshoot a gateway issue efficiently?
Verifying host settings, pinging the gateway, then testing beyond it
A host configured by DHCP suddenly loses remote access after a scope edit. What should be checked?
Whether the gateway option was changed incorrectly
Which symptom indicates the gateway is fine but DNS is the problem?
Remote hosts are reachable by IP but not by name
Which practice helps confirm a host uses the intended gateway?
Checking the host's active default route
A VLAN's gateway SVI is administratively down. What is the symptom?
Hosts in that VLAN can't reach other networks
Which fix restores a down SVI gateway?
Enabling the SVI with 'no shutdown' and ensuring a port is active in the VLAN
Which practice helps avoid gateway misconfiguration during moves?
Using DHCP so hosts receive the correct gateway automatically
A host's gateway points to a firewall that blocks its traffic. What should be checked?
The firewall's rules for that host's traffic
Which symptom confirms the gateway setting is correct and reachable?
The host can ping the gateway and reach remote networks
The host can't ping the gateway
Which BEST summarizes incorrect default gateway troubleshooting?
Verify the gateway is correct, on the right subnet, reachable, and forwarding, fixing it via DHCP or static settings
